images.name: s08_arjun_pour_r4_1
images.prompt: Seen from the side in profile, an 18-year-old Indian boy with a boyish clean-shaven face, dark brown skin and messy short black hair, wearing a long plain white cotton kurta with sleeves rolled up, a red cloth sash at his waist and a red string bracelet, pours chai the traditional way at his roadside tea stall: both arms in front of his body, his right hand lifts a steel kettle high, directly above the small glass tumbler held low in his left hand, and a long thin continuous stream of milky light-brown tea falls straight down from the kettle spout into the glass, glowing in the lantern light against the dark street behind. Steam rises from the glass. He grins. Evening street in Mumbai, out of focus, signs plain with no writing, a giant blue portal glowing faintly in the sky. Medium shot.
